inputs.text: [serious] Herbivore, mostly a loner. [calm] Its back was covered in bony plates, and its tail ended in a big club.
[nervous] Did T. rex dare attack it?
[warmly] It could try. [serious] But it was very risky: Ankylosaurus's weak spots — belly, eyes, legs — were all well hidden. And one swing of that club tail, [pauses] could break its leg.
